summary: Moved @huggingface/transformers to optionalDependencies — the embedder already degrades to keyword search when the import fails
context: npx installs failed in network-restricted environments because onnxruntime-node's postinstall downloads binaries; the dep was hard, so the whole install died.
rationale: embedder.ts loads the package only via await import() inside doInitialize's try/catch (single import site, grep-verified); absence flips fallbackMode. npm skips failed optionalDependencies subtrees, so a blocked postinstall no longer kills the install.

alternatives.reason_rejected: Install failure in proxied sandboxes and offline CI — proven in this repo's own remote sessions.
npx users would never get semantic search; optional keeps the default-on behavior where installs succeed.
